name: Flat reptile
summary: Parametric flat vector lizard, crocodile, snake, turtle or coiled snake; base of gecko, crocodile, snake, tortoise.

params.name: y
params.note: ground under the body

params.name: s
params.note: scale

params.name: body
params.note: lizard = 4 sprawling legs; croc = low, long, armoured; snake = no legs; turtle = shell, legs and head out; coil = snake coiled with raised head

params.name: pose
params.note: walk = legs swing from f; slither = wave travels from f (snake); idle = breathing, blink, tongue flick; raised = head up

params.name: len
params.note: body length without head, snout and tail, px at s = 1

params.name: bodyH
params.note: body thickness (snake: diameter; turtle: shell height)

params.name: head
params.note: head radius px

params.name: snout
params.note: snout length px

params.name: snoutShape
params.note: croc uses long unless broad (alligator U-shape)

params.name: tailLen
params.note: tail length px

params.name: tailCurl
params.note: chameleon-style upward curl of the tail tip

params.name: legLen
params.note: leg length px (turtle: short stumpy legs)

params.name: legW
params.note: leg thickness px, 0 = automatic

params.name: toes
params.note: pads = gecko sticky round toe pads

params.name: color
params.note: body colour; far legs and far details get one darker shade

params.name: belly
params.note: belly colour, or none

params.name: back
params.note: dorsal ridge or back stripe colour, or none; also tints spikes and plates

params.name: pattern
params.note: marking on the body

params.name: patternColor
params.note: colour of the markings

params.name: ridge
params.note: spikes = iguana dorsal spikes; plates = crocodile scutes

params.name: dewlap
params.note: throat flap colour (anole), or none

params.name: casque
params.note: chameleon-style helmet on top of the head

params.name: hood
params.note: cobra hood behind the head (coil only)

params.name: eyeSize
params.note: eye scale; gecko uses about 1.5

params.name: eyeBulge
params.note: chameleon turret eyes

params.name: teeth
params.note: small white teeth along the snout

params.name: tongue
params.note: forked tongue; flicks out from f in idle and slither

params.name: shell
params.note: turtle shell: dome = tall tortoise shell, flat = low turtle shell, sea = flat shell with flippers instead of legs

params.name: shellColor
params.note: shell colour (turtle body only)

params.name: plateColor
params.note: hex plate colour on the shell

params.name: flip
params.note: face left

params.name: vx
params.note: px per frame

author: krakujs
